reason: The README describes a presentation and routing layer for agent tools that stabilizes the visible tool surface, supports discovery and schema disclosure, and mediates later calls through ToolRuntime across Native, Code, and Both modes.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供渐进式工具发现、模式披露和运行时调用路由，同时保持稳定的模型可见工具界面。
summaries.en: Provides agents with progressive tool discovery, schema disclosure, and runtime call routing while keeping the model-visible tool surface stable.

capabilities: Progressively discloses available tools to agents
Searches and describes tool names, summaries, and schemas
Routes selected tool calls through the current ToolRuntime registry
Integrates with native model tool-search or tool-reference protocols when supported
Provides an invoke_tool fallback for unsupported native APIs
